description: DecZero is an Ecuadorian multidisciplinary team that brings together talent from the country's three mainland regions: Coast, Highlands, and Amazon. Our name stands for Declination 0° (Dec = 0°), the Celestial Equator, the privileged vantage point (0, 0, 0) from which both celestial hemispheres can be observed. Uniting backgrounds in physics, data analysis, UX/UI design, and science communication, we turn open NASA data into clear, interactive, and evidence-driven tools.
